name: onset-partition-redesign
title: Onset-objective partition redesign and 2-layer optimization
description: Re-target the spatial partitioning objective from level-prediction to onset within the persist=0 subset, fix the SMOTE confound between the pooled and partitioned arms, and re-optimize the 2-layer persistence-correction override against a new pre-registration aiming to beat persistence and approach or beat the FEWS NET expert.
